Fine Print · 1 of 3
01

The exclusion buried in an endorsement.

Coverage you thought you had can be quietly removed by a two-page endorsement added at renewal. We read your declarations, exclusions, and endorsements together — and translate the legalese into plain English.

Fine Print · 2 of 3
02

Depreciation math that shrinks your check.

“Actual cash value” means your roof gets paid like a used car. Carriers apply aggressive depreciation and hope you never claim the recoverable portion. We document, itemize, and pursue every dollar your policy actually owes.

Fine Print · 3 of 3
03

Storm damage, reclassified as “wear and tear.”

The fastest way to deny wind or water damage is to call it maintenance. Proper documentation — photos, moisture readings, a written narrative — is how that position gets challenged. And it can be.

A denial is a position, not a verdict.
